arStrings.szText: A strange discovery pushes the coven to action.
Caidin discovered a strange talisman inside the corpse attached to the head I hunted. He brought it back to the coven in the hopes of learning its origins. Perhaps they've gleaned something from it.
Alarmed by the talisman, the Coven has decided to restore what heads we've gathered back to the Tree. Once again, they've invited me to participate in the ritual. They await me in the ritual circle.
Ouna sabotaged the ritual and ran off with the heads, causing Caidin to give chase. Gelena and I might still be able to fix this mess if we can catch up to them.
